run_metadata.coverage_summary: Swept all nine Tier-1 government portals (AusTender, buy.nsw / NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/Queensland Supplier Portal, Tenders WA, SA Tenders and Contracts, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) via live web search, prioritising notices published or updated in the last 7 days. Tier-2 sampled across GBEs/water utilities (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, NBN Co), universities (Macquarie, University of Sydney) and public health (HealthShare NSW/VIC, Local Health Districts). Tier-3 corporate channel checked as mandated (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery) — no publicly-visible Australian RFx surfaced without a supplier login this run. Most currently-open notices seen today were already captured in prior runs (through 2026-08-05): one genuinely new opportunity was confirmed (Macquarie University Hard FM & Soft Services EOI) and three still-open known Commonwealth/university notices were re-confirmed as active. Found four genuinely new buyer-originated sources (Logan City Council QLD, Hornsby Shire Council NSW, Scenic Rim Regional Council QLD, Bendigo Health VIC). Note: many buyer portals (AusTender detail pages, NSW eTendering, NT QTOL and several council pages) returned HTTP 403 to the automated fetcher, so detail was reconstructed from AusTender/search summaries rather than the full notice pages.
gaps: AusTender ATM detail pages (tenders.gov.au/Atm/Show/...) consistently returned HTTP 403 to the automated fetcher; details for ATM_2026_6786 and ATM_2026_6489 were reconstructed from AusTender current-ATM search summaries, not the full notice pages.

NSW eTendering (tenders.nsw.gov.au) and NT QTOL (tendersonline.nt.gov.au) returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher; current-tender detail could not be deep-linked this run and was read only via search summaries.

New buyer-originated council/health pages (Hornsby Shire Council, Logan City Council VendorPanel page, Scenic Rim Regional Council, Bendigo Health) returned HTTP 403/robots to the fetcher; their existence and buyer-origin were confirmed via search but live opportunity lists could not be read this run.

EFA2026015 (Export Finance Australia — Mechanical Repairs & Maintenance, Export Finance House, 22 Pitt St Sydney) still appears on the AusTender current-ATM list, but the previously-recorded closing date was 2026-07-15; whether the notice has been re-issued/extended could not be verified (detail page 403). Not re-confirmed as active this run to avoid asserting an unverified open status.

SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: no publicly-visible Australian RFx surfaced via search; full opportunity detail requires a free supplier login. Recorded as a registration-gated portal; no individual corporate opportunity captured this run (none publicly visible without authentication).
Tier-3 invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs (e.g. to Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte) remain out of scope — never publicly published — and were not fabricated.

URL change observed: the Queensland Government Tenders Directory now resolves at qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au (the prompt's seed lists qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au); Queensland is also migrating agencies to VendorPanel via supply.qld.gov.au. Seed URL should be updated.
recommended_seed_additions: Logan City Council (QLD) — publishes public tenders on its own VendorPanel buyer page (vendorpanel.com.au/logancity/tenders).
Hornsby Shire Council (NSW) — Tenders, RFQs & EOIs noticeboard on its own council site (hornsby.nsw.gov.au/council/noticeboard/tenders-rfqs-eois).
Scenic Rim Regional Council (QLD) — Tenders and Expressions of Interest page on its own council site.
Bendigo Health (VIC) — regional public health service publishing a 2026 Procurement Activity Plan; major tenders likely run via HealthShare Victoria (JAGGAER).

tenders.title: Request for EOI — Hard FM and Soft Services (cleaning, security and related soft services)
tenders.category: Facilities management / cleaning / security / soft services
tenders.description: Macquarie University is undertaking a review of its cleaning, security and related soft services delivery model and has released an Expression of Interest covering hard facilities management (FM) and soft services, to keep the campus environment safe, clean, resilient and aligned with standards.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of integrated facilities management across the Macquarie University campus — including cleaning, security and related soft services (with hard FM as scoped) — delivered to a standard that keeps the campus safe, clean and well-maintained. The EOI is the first stage of a review of the University's soft-services delivery model; full deliverables, staging and any subsequent RFT scope are defined in the tender documents.
key_deliverables: Related soft services (as scoped in the EOI)
tenders.eligibility: Open to suitably qualified and experienced facilities management / cleaning / security providers; registration on the Macquarie University e-Tendering portal (illion TenderLink) is required to access the EOI documents.
tenders.submission_method: Lodge via the Macquarie University e-Tendering portal (illion TenderLink)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via web search; the opportunity is published on Macquarie University's own e-Tendering portal (illion TenderLink, portal.tenderlink.com/mq). An aggregator listing surfaced its existence, but the buyer-originated TenderLink portal is recorded here as the source of truth. Not present in any prior run.
tenders.notes: Headline-level capture only — tender reference number, closing date, contract term and full scope sit behind the TenderLink free-registration login and could not be confirmed this run. Needs a detail pass in a future authenticated run.

tenders.title: GEMS verification (check) testing — electrical and gas products (accredited testing laboratory panel)
tenders.buyer: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW)
tenders.description: DCCEEW is seeking accredited testing laboratories to provide verification (check) testing of electrical and gas products registered under the Greenhouse and Energy Minimum Standards (GEMS) scheme, to confirm regulated products meet their registered energy-efficiency and performance requirements.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of verification (check) testing of electrical and gas products registered under the GEMS scheme — laboratories test sampled products against the relevant standards so the regulator can confirm ongoing compliance. Establishes a deed/panel arrangement for testing services over the contract period.
key_deliverables: Accredited verification/check testing of registered electrical products
Accredited verification/check testing of registered gas products
Test reports supporting GEMS compliance/regulatory action
tenders.eligibility: Accredited testing laboratories with capability against the relevant electrical/gas product standards.
tenders.contract_term: Deed anticipated to commence 1 November 2026 and conclude 30 June 2030, with a one-year extension option
tenders.reasoning: Previously captured; re-confirmed still open (closing 2026-08-12) on the AusTender current-ATM list this run to mark it active.
tenders.notes: Detail reconstructed from the AusTender search summary; the full ATM detail page returned HTTP 403 to the automated fetcher.

tenders.title: Expression of Interest — Education and Training Services Centre for Pacific Energy Transition
tenders.buyer: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW)
tenders.category: Education and training services / international development
tenders.description: DCCEEW is seeking a supplier to establish and deliver an Education and Training Services Centre supporting the Pacific energy transition — developing and delivering workplans and projects for Pacific partner countries at bilateral and regional level, including technical assistance, modelling and analysis, and skills and training. Multi-stage procurement beginning with this EOI.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Establish and run a Centre that develops and delivers workplans and projects for Pacific partner countries to support their energy transition — providing technical assistance, modelling and analysis, and skills-and-training programs from the Centre's establishment through to June 2029, with possible extension to June 2031.
key_deliverables: Establishment and operation of the Education and Training Services Centre
Bilateral and regional workplans and projects for Pacific partner countries
Skills and training programs supporting the energy transition
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market; multi-stage (EOI followed by later stages).
tenders.contract_term: From Centre establishment to June 2029, with possible extension to June 2031
tenders.reasoning: Previously captured; re-confirmed still open (closing 2026-08-17) on the AusTender current-ATM list this run to mark it active.
tenders.notes: Detail reconstructed from the AusTender search summary; the full ATM detail page returned HTTP 403 to the automated fetcher.

tenders.title: Campus Master Plan — four Expression of Interest opportunities for leading consultants
tenders.description: The University of Sydney is updating its Camperdown-Darlington Campus Master Plan (CMP) to guide the next generation of campus transformation, and will shortly release four Expressions of Interest for leading consultants. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor the University's eTender portal for release dates. Procurement follows a two-stage, quality-based selection (EOI then RFT for shortlisted respondents).
tenders.deliverables_summary: Consultancy services to support the update of the University of Sydney's Camperdown-Darlington Campus Master Plan across four EOI packages — planning, design and advisory inputs guiding the next generation of campus transformation. Full package scopes to be defined when the four EOIs are released.
key_deliverables: Consultant inputs to the Camperdown-Darlington Campus Master Plan update (four EOI packages)
tenders.eligibility: Two-stage, quality-based selection: EOI followed by RFT for shortlisted respondents; leading consultants across relevant disciplines.
tenders.submission_method: Via the University of Sydney eTender portal (monitor for release)
tenders.detail_source: Web search summary; procurement contact confirmed (fredrik.bengtsson@sydney.edu.au)
tenders.reasoning: Previously captured; re-confirmed active and enriched with the procurement contact (Fred Bengtsson, Strategic Sourcing Manager) this run.
tenders.notes: The four EOIs are to be released to guide the Camperdown-Darlington Campus Master Plan update; release dates and closing dates are to be posted on the USYD eTender portal and were not yet published this run. Headline-level, pending detail.
